method: Independent standard-library parsing of stored raw CLI streams, exact request/response/feedback comparisons, recalculation of all recorded native stdout values/resource counters and per-arm totals; no pilot/evaluator imports, no model calls and no native workload reruns.

observed_time_order.scope: Commit/registration timestamps and root-recorded ref-before-START order are observed metadata, not cryptographically trusted timestamp attestation.

native_record_recalculation.scope: Read and re-evaluate existing recorded stdout and resource counters against the frozen recorded expected vectors. This is not a new execution or an independent semantic oracle.

limitations: The complete registered denominator is four tasks per arm; six failed HIA public attempts and both unsuccessful cells remain included.
Only the new benchmark requests have complete observed CLI usage; the prior header-only bootstrap, human work and full service lifecycle costs remain incomplete.
Raw input/output fields are reported directly; cached input is a subset, not an additional token charge. Reasoning-inclusive charged tokens are conservative and may overlap output tokens.

Per-arm wall values are sums of actual CLI-process elapsed times and separately of validation-worker elapsed times. They are not isolated compiler-performance measurements and exclude some host orchestration overhead.
The common alias is not a provider weights/route attestation. Sampling, inherited ambient instructions and provider cache are uncontrolled.
No observed tool events in complete accepted streams is evidence at the CLI boundary, not proof that all possible provider-side access was impossible.
These are previously used finite synthetic tasks. One pilot does not establish statistical or general productivity superiority, unseen-workload performance, soundness or C/C++ migration cost.

The preregistration API object was retrieved and supplied by root; this audit verifies its local exact bytes and timing consistency, not a separate remote-network retrieval or trusted timestamp service.

Nine model cwd path names are currently empty directories despite receipts recording removal. Process cleanup receipts and initial mkdir semantics are checked; permanent absence of every path is not established.

audit_corrections.issue: Reviewer resource mapping omitted calibration owner_flow_repair when deriving provider bounds from task names.
audit_corrections.correction: Extract task/provider identifiers from the frozen calibration entries and main specs AST without importing or executing the evaluator. owner_flow_repair uses touch: at most one allocation and peak eight bytes. Recompute every one of the 34 recorded public/hidden native observation sets.

audit_corrections.issue: Reviewer added a post-run path-nonexistence requirement absent from the frozen launch protocol.
audit_corrections.correction: Keep the actual 23 cleanup receipts and separately disclose the nine currently existing empty paths. The audit does not infer launch contamination or permanent filesystem deletion from later empty directories.

post_run_cwd_observation.interpretation: Nine empty path names are currently observable although each receipt records successful rmdir. Their later existence is not explained by this audit; no directory contents or tool events show answer access. This is retained as an environment/cleanup-observation limitation, not silently rewritten as permanent deletion or as a failed model qualification.

reporting_caveats.effect: The ticket is a live snapshot before final aggregate counters are computed. Its three actual qualifying request records are complete; do not report its initialized top-level zero as zero incurred requests.
